title: Native artifact targets the wrong libc
summary: A pre-existing musl-linked x64 N-API v1 addon declares libc.so while the fixed Linux x64/glibc runtime expects libc.so.6; the same-source glibc layer remains content-addressed for the intervention arm.

proof_eligibility.reason: The planned case changes one typed dimension inside the supported Linux isolation backend.

oracle.description: The unchanged fixture assertion exits zero and emits the DEV-NATIVE-003 success marker.

scenario.failure_mode: The loader hash-validates the selected addon, parses its ELF64 little-endian dynamic section, and rejects the checked musl libc.so dependency before require because the fixed runtime is glibc. A separate Host smoke records Node's real glibc-loader failure without treating that text as the libc classification evidence.
planned_setup: Provide glibc and musl content-addressed Linux x64 addons compiled from the same C N-API v1 source and Node 22 headers.
Keep CPU architecture, N-API module ABI version, source revision, C language level, loader assertion, and dependencies fixed.
Select the musl libc.so layer in A1 and A2; select the glibc libc.so.6 layer only in B.
Treat the checked ELF DT_NEEDED entry as the libc evidence and the direct Node loading failure only as a separate execution smoke.
